# FLX-3105: bundle does not validate, so its seam cannot be resolved

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Resolution delegates to the FLUX offline reference validator: every reference resolves, every id is unique, every weight sums, and every in-bundle FLUID document is valid for its declared version. A bundle that fails those checks has no seam to resolve, and repairing it here would mean the engine ran against something the validator refused. The same code refuses a declaration the run cannot generate: a links, bridges, counts, weights or copies block, or a reference expose on kernel 0.1.0, which refuses what kernel 0.2.0 adds and names the kernel in the message; a reference expose with no profile pinned, or a pinned profile that publishes no rows for it; a profile overlay the reader refuses, in a file or in a Simulation or as a plan records it (a name outside [a-z][a-z0-9-]*, a patch that touches more than a table's rowCount, its columns' metrics and statistics, columnPairs and periods, and the profile's relationships and invariants, a number written as a decimal, a restated statistic with a noise block), an overlay that names a table or a column the pinned profile does not hold or makes a document the profile reader refuses, one that gives a table with a history another rowCount (the entities are read from a history no overlay can patch, so only the chains would change), and one in a Simulation that pins no profile; and a link sentinel on a copy whose derive has a when, since a row that fails the when keeps a drawn value, not the sentinel. A history, asOf, snapshots, events or periods entry is refused on kernel 0.1.0, which has no chain of versions to read, and its block is refused when it is not a list of entries (or a mapping for one emit), or when an entry carries a key the block does not know at any level; the message names the entry and the key.

$ fluxsim explain FLX-3105
